Senses.Explanation: The great intent of the coming from the west. Xueqiao Yuanxin tells a donor-feast assembly that coughing, spitting, swinging the arms — all of it is the ancestor's westward intent, needing only one who truly trusts it, Yunwai Xingze tells trainees who came to fathom it that they are already wrong, for he has sat at their crown-door for measureless kalpas, closer than seeking, and Guxue Zhenzhe sings it wholly clear in a spring verse where flowers bud and trees sprout. Dabo Qian has it sprouting in a hundred grasses at the New Year, Poshan Haiming warns that reading the stick by where it hurts has long since blotted it out, Wanru Tongwei rules that before the fifteenth day it wholly exists and cannot be brought up, Hanyue Fazang pours it out by the bushel where the rankless true person's means are strong, Zhe'an Jingfan's enthronement proclamation announces that he opens and expounds it, Huanyou Zhengchuan answers a guest's question by pointing at the ancient mirror and then urgently demands the westward intent handed back — and the guest awakens — and Yinyuan Longqi tosses it away with the gourd on the east wall and smashes the nest of right and wrong.
